text_en: The Lord said to Moses,
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟说：

text_en: “Send men to spy out the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the Israelites; from each of their ancestral tribes you shall send a man, every one a leader among them. ”
text_cn: “你要派遣一些人去窥探我要赐给以色列子民的客纳罕地；每一宗族支派应派遣一人去，个个都应是他们中的领袖。”

text_en: So Moses sent them from the wilderness of Paran, according to the command of the Lord , all of them leading men among the Israelites.
text_cn: 梅瑟就依照上主的命令，从帕兰旷野派遣他们去了；这些人全是以色列子民的首领。

text_en: These were their names: From the tribe of Reuben, Shammua son of Zaccur;
text_cn: 以下是他们的名字：勒乌本支派是匝雇尔的儿子沙慕亚；

text_en: from the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat son of Hori;
text_cn: 西默盎支派是曷黎的儿子沙法特；

text_en: from the tribe of Judah, Caleb son of Jephunneh;
text_cn: 犹大支派是耶孚乃的儿子加肋布；

text_en: from the tribe of Issachar, Igal son of Joseph;
text_cn: 依撒加尔支派，是若瑟的儿子依卡耳；

text_en: from the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea son of Nun;
text_cn: 厄弗辣因支派是农的儿子曷舍亚；

text_en: from the tribe of Benjamin, Palti son of Raphu;
text_cn: 本雅明支派是辣富的儿子帕耳提；

text_en: from the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel son of Sodi;
text_cn: 则步隆支派是索狄的儿子加狄耳；

text_en: from the tribe of Joseph (that is, from the tribe of Manasseh), Gaddi son of Susi;
text_cn: 若瑟支派，即默纳协支派是稣息的儿子加狄；

text_en: from the tribe of Dan, Ammiel son of Gemalli;
text_cn: 丹支派是革玛里的儿子阿米耳；

text_en: from the tribe of Asher, Sethur son of Michael;
text_cn: 阿协尔支派是米加耳的儿子色突尔；

text_en: from the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi son of Vophsi;
text_cn: 纳斐塔里支派是沃斐息的儿子纳赫彼；

text_en: from the tribe of Gad, Geuel son of Machi.
text_cn: 加得支派是玛基的儿子革乌耳；

text_en: These were the names of the men whom Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses changed the name of Hoshea son of Nun to Joshua.
text_cn: 以上是梅瑟派去窥探那地方的人名；梅瑟给农的儿子曷舍亚起名叫若苏厄。

text_en: Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said to them, “Go up there into the Negeb, and go up into the hill country,
text_cn: 当梅瑟派遣他们窥探客纳罕地时，向他们说：“你们由此上乃革布去，然后上山区去，

text_en: and see what the land is like, and whether the people who live in it are strong or weak, whether they are few or many,
text_cn: 窥看那地方怎样，看住在那地方的人民是强盛或是软弱，是稀少或是众多；

text_en: and whether the land they live in is good or bad, and whether the towns that they live in are unwalled or fortified,
text_cn: 他们住的地方是好，或是坏；他们居住的城镇是不设防，或是设防的；

text_en: and whether the land is rich or poor, and whether there are trees in it or not. Be bold, and bring some of the fruit of the land. ” Now it was the season of the first ripe grapes.
text_cn: 有什么土壤，是肥沃或是贫瘠；在那里有没有树木。你们应勇敢，带些那地方的果子来。”那时是葡萄初熟的时节。

text_en: So they went up and spied out the land from the wilderness of Zin to Rehob, near Lebo-hamath.
text_cn: 他们遂上去，窥探了那地方，从亲旷野直到勒曷布，哈玛特关口。

text_en: They went up into the Negeb, and came to Hebron; and Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the Anakites, were there. (Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt. )
text_cn: 他们上到乃革布，来到了赫贝龙。在那里有阿纳克的后裔阿希曼、舍瑟和塔耳买。──赫贝龙城比埃及左罕城早建七年。

text_en: And they came to the Wadi Eshcol, and cut down from there a branch with a single cluster of grapes, and they carried it on a pole between two of them. They also brought some pomegranates and figs.
text_cn: 他们一直来到厄市苛耳山谷，砍下了一枝只有一嘟噜的葡萄，两人用杠子抬着，又摘了些石榴和无花果。

text_en: That place was called the Wadi Eshcol, because of the cluster that the Israelites cut down from there.
text_cn: 人称那地方为厄市苛耳山谷，因为以色列子民从那里砍去了一嘟噜葡萄。

text_en: At the end of forty days they returned from spying out the land.
text_cn: 四十天后，他们由侦探的地方回来，

text_en: And they came to Moses and Aaron and to all the congregation of the Israelites in the wilderness of Paran, at Kadesh; they brought back word to them and to all the congregation, and showed them the fruit of the land.
text_cn: 到了帕兰旷野的卡德士去见梅瑟、亚郎和以色列子民的全会众，给他们和全会众报告，叫他们看那地方的果子。

text_en: And they told him, “We came to the land to which you sent us; it flows with milk and honey, and this is its fruit.
text_cn: 他们向梅瑟报告说：“我们到了你派遣我们去的那个地方，实在是流奶流蜜的地方；这是那地方的出产。

text_en: Yet the people who live in the land are strong, and the towns are fortified and very large; and besides, we saw the descendants of Anak there.
text_cn: 只是住在那地方的人强盛，城镇坚固广大，而且我们在那里也见到了阿纳克的后裔。

text_en: The Amalekites live in the land of the Negeb; the Hittites, the Jebusites, and the Amorites live in the hill country; and the Canaanites live by the sea, and along the Jordan. ”
text_cn: 阿玛肋克人住在乃革布地方；赫特人、耶步斯人和阿摩黎人住在山区；客纳罕人住在海滨和约但河沿岸一带。”

text_en: But Caleb quieted the people before Moses, and said, “Let us go up at once and occupy it, for we are well able to overcome it. ”
text_cn: 加肋布使百姓在梅瑟前镇静说：“我们尽管上去，必要占领那地方。我们必能战胜。”

text_en: Then the men who had gone up with him said, “We are not able to go up against this people, for they are stronger than we. ”
text_cn: 但是与他同去的人却说：“我们不能前去攻打那民族，因为他们比我们强盛。”

text_en: So they brought to the Israelites an unfavorable report of the land that they had spied out, saying, “The land that we have gone through as spies is a land that devours its inhabitants; and all the people that we saw in it are of great size.
text_cn: 于是他们在以色列子民中，对所侦探的地方散布谣言说：“我们侦探所经过的地方，是个吞噬当地居民的地方；我们在那里所见到的民族，都是高大的人。

text_en: There we saw the Nephilim (the Anakites come from the Nephilim); and to ourselves we seemed like grasshoppers, and so we seemed to them. ”
text_cn: 在那里还见到了巨人，即巨人的后裔，阿纳克的子孙；我们看自己好像是蚱蜢；在他们看来，我们也实在如此。”
